Komal Kumar And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 14
August, 2024

Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:131963

Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 24573 of 2024

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Shekhar Gangal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Abhishek Gupta,G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for opposite party no. 2/informant and learned AGA for the State.
2. This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the entire proceedings,
including charge-sheet dated 19.09.2021 and cognizance/summoning order dated 30.05.2022, of case No. 21406 of 2022 (State Vs. Komal Kumar and others), arising out of case crime no. 652 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 354, 504, 313 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Delhi Gate,
District Aligarh, pending in the court of A.C.J.M.-IIIrd, Aligarh, on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.

sentences.text: It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicants as well as by learned counsel for opposite party no. 2/informant that the matter relates to matrimonial dispute and now both the parties have amicably settled the dispute and compromised the matter.
Applicant no.1 is husband of informant/opposite party no.2 and remaining applicants are family members of applicant no.1.
It was submitted that now both the parties are residing together and the informant does not want to pursue the proceedings pending before the trial Court.
Applicant no.1 and opposite party no.2 have also filed a joint affidavit, wherein they have reiterated they have settled the dispute and impugned proceedings may be quashed.
It was submitted that as the matter relates to matrimonial dispute thus, in view of compromise of the parties, no useful purpose would be served by keeping the prosecution case pending.
4. Learned A.G.A. has no objection if parties compromise the matter.
5. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.
6. In the instant case, it appears that matter relates to matrimonial dispute, which is private in nature.
If parties compromise the matter, it would not have adverse impact on society.
There is nothing to indicate that parties have any criminal antecedents.
The informant does not want to proceed with the case against the applicants.
Both the parties have filed a joint affidavit, stating that they have compromised the matter and impugned proceedings may be quashed.

Considering the law laid down in the case of State of Madhya Pradesh Vs. Laxmi Narayan and others, AIR 2019 SC 1296 and the facts of the matter, it would be in the interest of justice that the impugned proceedings be quashed, as the continuance of the same would be nothing but wastage of time of Court.

entities.text: State of Madhya Pradesh Vs. Laxmi Narayan and others, AIR 2019 SC 1296
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. In view of the aforesaid, the impugned charge-sheet/cognizance-summoning order and entire proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case against applicants, namely, Komal Kumar, Summer Singh, Rameshwari Devi, Bhola @ Praveen, Gajendra & Prempal Singh are hereby quashed.
8. The application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed.
